name: The Herd-Child
pitch: The family's old plough buffalo outranks you by a realm: you play the flute, it does the killing, and when you fall it stands over you and pays for it with what is left of its life.

new.name: Fights as Itself
new.effect: A companion hits with its own realm's fight unit, stage and suppression gap, not its owner's. c_comp_cap and the owner's M stay.
new.second_home: any elder's inherited beast; NPC sect guardians

new.name: Stands Over You
new.effect: When you go Down, your companion stays on its own health and guard with no ward, and the fight goes on until it falls. Needs loyalty 60 or more.
new.second_home: any companion; beasts guarding a sect's fallen

new.name: Broad Back
new.effect: Each 1.0 of c_comp the cap clips moves 10 % of each hit on your health to the beast, to 40 %, against its guard. Overkill is not moved. If its wounds reach its health it dies.
new.second_home: capability #17 holders, whose beast clips too

new.name: Carried Note
new.effect: Tag modifiers on an art you fired this instant also apply to your companion's hit in that instant.
new.second_home: any art build that keeps a beast

new.name: In Step
new.effect: +50 points to a hit landing after one of your arts in the same instant.
new.second_home: any volley; used by The Already-Waited

new.name: Full Trough
new.effect: +20 points to companion hits per doubling of the year's feed above what is due, to +40. A blind fight keeps it.

new.name: Reed Song
new.effect: +60 points to arts with the song form.

new.name: The Old Plough Buffalo
new.effect: Earth, beast form, a realm above its owner. Fixed art Long Furrow, a body hit. In the Stand: n_body 2.0, t_b 2.0, body_guard_pct 60, no ward.

new.name: Plough-Song Method
new.effect: Main, Hoàng giai, Earth. lifespan_years 15. A rhythm for walking behind an animal. Seals Old Yoke.

new.name: Calling Note
new.effect: Qi hit, c_art 1.2, cost 0.03, 1 s, song form.

new.name: Rain Song
new.effect: Curse, +50 % ward drain for 3 pulses, cost 0.05, 2 s.

new.name: Low Song
new.effect: Curse, -30 % body guard for 3 pulses, cost 0.05, 2 s.

new.name: Furrow Song
new.effect: Curse, ward pass x1.5 for 3 pulses, cost 0.05, 2 s.

new.name: Home Call
new.effect: Escape, cost 0.10, 3 s, guard own health below 30 %. Unmodelled.

new.name: Neck Bell
new.effect: A generated Chuông the family already owned.

new.name: Old Yoke
new.effect: Sealed, Beast Taming, Earth, outer, size 10. Notables In Step, then Broad Back with Fights as Itself as its capability.

new.name: Way of the Herd
new.effect: Earth at purity 30. theme_stats khi_huyet_pct, linh_luc_regen_pct, art_speed_pct, body_guard_pct. Branches The Rope, The Song, The Field. Keystone Stands Over You. 20 nodes, no art nodes.

new.name: Shared Years
new.effect: A beast has a lifespan by its realm, and its owner may give it years of their own. Each 1 % of health it loses in a fight costs it 1 year.

questions: Combat rule 19 and Open Question 3 closed targeting of companions on 2026-11-06. Stands Over You and Broad Back ask to reopen it for this keystone alone. Is that allowed?
Should an owned beast be able to outrun its owner by a realm at all? The world tick seems to allow it.
Is permanent beast death acceptable as a cost the player can lose to a single top-end blow?
